title: Malawi Groundwater Monitoring Time-Series Dataset (2024–2025)
text: dataset contains groundwater monitoring data collected monitoring wells across 10 districts Malawi 2024 2025. data captured using automated data loggers installed monitoring wells collected managed BASEflow. dataset provides time-series measurements key groundwater parameters, enabling detailed analysis aquifer behavior across multiple geographic locations. Variables Included Date – Date measurement Waterpoint Name – Name monitoring site District – Administrative district monitoring well located Latitude & Longitude – Geographic coordinates monitoring well Source – Data collection method (automated data logger) Water Level – Groundwater level measurement (typically meters ground level, depending installation reference) Temperature – Groundwater temperature (°C) Conductivity – Electrical conductivity (µS/cm), indicating dissolved ion concentration groundwater quality characteristics use automated loggers ensures high-frequency, consistent, reliable measurements suitable time-series analysis hydrogeological assessment. Purpose Use Cases 1. Groundwater Resource Monitoring Tracking spatial temporal groundwater level variations across districts Assessing seasonal recharge depletion patterns Identifying long-term aquifer trends Water Quality Surveillance Monitoring conductivity trends proxy salinity mineralization Detecting potential contamination quality shifts Climate Drought Analysis Supporting drought early warning systems Evaluating groundwater resilience climate variability Infrastructure Management Informing borehole design pump installation depths Supporting preventive maintenance planning Assessing borehole performance time Hydrogeological Research Modelling Input data groundwater flow recharge models Calibration aquifer simulations Comparative inter-district hydrogeological analysis Policy, Regulation, Planning Evidence base district-level national water resource planning Supporting groundwater abstraction regulation Informing investment decisions rural urban water supply Potential Users Ministry responsible Water district water offices Hydrologists hydrogeologists WASH sector NGOs implementing partners Academic research institutions Climate environmental analysts Development partners supporting water security resilience programs dataset provides structured, multi-district groundwater evidence base support sustainable groundwater management water security planning Malawi.

title: Malawi Groundwater Monitoring Time-Series Dataset (2024–2025)
code:
library(mwgroundwaterdata) # Visualization: Geospatial Map # Import the libraries to be used library(tidyverse) library(lubridate) library(leaflet) # Create summary dataset INSIDE the README well_summary <- mwgroundwaterdata %>% group_by(waterpoint_name, latitude, longitude, district) %>% summarise( avg_water_level = mean(water_level, na.rm = TRUE), avg_conductivity = mean(conductivity, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop" ) leaflet(well_summary) %>% addTiles() %>% # OpenStreetMap tiles addCircleMarkers(~longitude, ~latitude, radius = ~avg_conductivity/400, color = ~colorNumeric("plasma", avg_water_level)(avg_water_level), popup = ~paste0(waterpoint_name, "
Avg Water Level: ", round(avg_water_level,2), "
Avg Conductivity: ", round(avg_conductivity,1))) %>% addLegend("bottomright", pal = colorNumeric("plasma", well_summary$avg_water_level), values = well_summary$avg_water_level, title = "Avg Water Level (m)")
